classification: Implemented browser-approval SERVER CORE with owning controls. Not complete browser-independent UI, real browser, OS restart, SSD, full issue acceptance or merge qualification.

runtimeOwnership.sessionRegistry: Existing per-BFF registry; approval-bound mint, original absolute expiry, rotation, cookie repair, active-operation release and approval revocation.
runtimeOwnership.privateStore: Existing protected UiStore; additive schema45 public identity/approval tables and persisted observation floor. No private key, cookie, proof or bearer persisted.
runtimeOwnership.routes: Six bounded routes under the existing app-session cookie family. Existing Host/Origin/CSRF guards plus exact transport Origin on new POSTs. Only an already approved session can approve or revoke.
runtimeOwnership.logging: Registered coding-app-session.browser-approval.state on the existing Activity Log, with action, outcome and actual session count only.

controls.crypto: Actual Node WebCrypto P256 signatures verified by Node crypto using the shared domain-separated bytes. Not native browser proof.
controls.http: Actual mounted BFF, real ephemeral loopback HTTP; test-only injected launcher pairing seam. Protected chat draft save/read succeeds after approval and is refused after revocation.
controls.restart: Recomposed production service/registry over the actual SQLite owner; not a real process/browser restart.
controls.relocation: Closed and reopened the actual private SQLite store after moving its temporary directory; not SSD qualification.
controls.independentReview: Auditor actual-owner checks: persisted-known-expiry7/7; release-first-observer4/4. Scope is those repairs only.

limitations: Requester and approval UI, IndexedDB persistence, and boot/recovery integration remain to implement and qualify.
Real Chrome/Safari/Firefox, profile, restart and SSD flows remain open.
Cookies are not isolated by TCP port. Nonextractability and origin-scoped storage do not protect against hostile same-origin script or local origin takeover.
No protection claimed against privileged OS clock/state tampering or restoration of revoked state from an old database backup.
Schema45 is forward-only. Packaged updater rollback/state compatibility remains unqualified; no release version or installed-state change is claimed.
The broader updater, skill benefit, Chat/search, original96, CI/review and merge criteria remain open.
retainedFailures: Initial test KeyObject return annotation failed strict typecheck and was corrected.
A direct route import exposed a runtime module cycle. The existing STREAMING sentinel now comes directly from its owning route-outcome module; the bounded reader stays in its original owner.

The first Activity Log check rejected new bare catches and the temporary reader relocation. The original reader owner was retained; pure URL validation uses URL.canParse, malformed-point handling catches only ERR_CRYPTO_INVALID_JWK, and unexpected cryptographic failures propagate to existing diagnostics.

Initial generator output used stale compiled failure-class contracts; contracts were rebuilt, the existing failure-class obligations were strengthened and the catalog regenerated with zero violations.
Both independent expiry findings and all prior failed logs remain retained.
